notes: Camera: register_table_camera(source='setup'); the 10 cm grid lies on the cloth (camera_check.png).
Frame 0 has a green colour cast (auto white balance settles by 1.8 s); colours were measured on frame 0 so the mug reads green-grey.
Created skill construct_bottle_straw (fork of construct_bottle) adds the drinking tube on the cap; it is rigid; see the rel rebuild note for its collision pairs.

In the scene the thread carrier and the cap were lowered 0.7 mm (cap ceiling 0.2 mm onto the mouth) so the seated cap bears on the bottle lip and is supported; the thread test ran on the unlowered build.

The bottle silhouette IoU (0.62) is against the full bottle mask while bottle_bottle renders only the body; the body-only fit IoU is 0.93. The real cap is a domed sports cap with a carry loop, modelled as a 57 mm x 40 mm cylinder, hence cap IoU 0.59.

Mug height (76 mm) and radii were refined from the placement overlay (the 95 mm first build rendered taller than the mask); fit_object_placement's scale fit returned an implausible 0.31 and was not used.

color_match_check reports the dominant colour by geometry share without alpha, so the translucent straw (coloured with the measured light-blue palette entry, the clear plastic as seen in the footage) dominates; the body's own colour equals palette entry 1 exactly.

Rel rebuild 2026-10-05 (scripts/rel_fix_scene.py): (1) the cap body is renamed bottle_bottle_cap -> bottle_bottle_cap_assembly so the Stage 1 id 'cap_assembly' resolves to it (the weld follows the name); (2) keyframe 0 had the cap 11.7 mm / 160 deg off the carrier its active weld bottle_bottle_engaged holds it to (MuJoCo reset on a bad acceleration at 0.024 s): the cap now starts on its carrier; (3) stale keyframe servo ctrl synced to the keyframe joints; (4) the drinking straw (bottle_bottle_straw) gets explicit contact pairs with the table and every mug collision geom and a 2 g mass, so it can no longer pass through the tabletop when the cap is put down. Robot, stations, table and physics options are untouched. The staged asset assets/bottle/bottle.xml carries the same cap rename so hand scenes built from it name the cap like the bench.
